description: Fixed replayable affine 2-planes in A^4_(A,B,Y,Z). Each plane is (s,t) |-> linear forms with integer coefficients listed as (const, coeff_s, coeff_t).
usage: Discovery only for plane sections of V(H,s1). Empty section does not prove unit ideal. Gate-pass F_p points do not prove T8-S1-NONUNIT without exact char-0 lift.
